students_inviteHint: Send an invitation email so the student can join and set their password.
queue_externalShare: Off-system share: {amount} · {teachers, plural, one {# teacher} other {# teachers}}
detail_walletTopupDesc: Record a cash top-up to this student's wallet.
detail_blacklistConfirmSuffix: . They will lose access to the platform.
detail_blacklistWarning: Blacklisting removes the student from active enrollments and blocks new sign-ups.
queue_title: {n, plural, one {# decision waiting today} other {# decisions waiting today}}
queue_subtitle: Every money action here is written into the center's ledger immediately. Review, then approve.
queue_requestsFact: Each one keeps a student out of their sessions.
queue_defaultersFact: An unpaid student is not counted present until settled.
queue_todayFact: Open the counter to check in and collect.
queue_allClear: Nothing is waiting on you. The record is up to date.
students_cascade_none: No active enrolments — this only blocks future enrolment.
students_cascade_countLine: The student will be withdrawn from {n, plural, one {# active enrolment} other {# active enrolments}} at your center:
students_cascade_reversible: Every withdrawal is journalled. Lifting the blacklist restores exactly these enrolments — no more, no fewer.
students_cascade_moneyNote: A blacklist touches no payment, subscription or wallet. Nothing is refunded and no subscription is cancelled.
students_cascade_reasonPlaceholder: e.g. repeated unexcused absence, conduct in class…
students_cascade_commit: Blacklist and withdraw {n, plural, one {# enrolment} other {# enrolments}}
students_cascade_hint: Two steps: the first press arms the button, the second performs the withdrawal.
students_cascade_armedHint: The next press withdraws the enrolments above and records the blacklist in your name.
students_cascade_finality: On confirm the student loses their place in the sessions above immediately, and the blacklist is recorded in your name in the audit log.
students_importHint: Upload a CSV or TSV exported from your old system or from Excel. It needs a header row with a name column (e.g. "name"), plus optional phone, national ID, guardian name and guardian phone columns.
students_importDownloadHint: Saves every row's outcome with the student code it was given — the only record that can reconcile this migration later, and it cannot be recovered once this dialog closes.
students_importPreviewTitle: Preview — nothing has been saved yet
students_importMatchedElsewhere: exists — not on your roster yet
students_importNoMoney: Importing only adds students to the center roster — no subscriptions, no payments, no group enrolment.
students_importReuseNote: A student we already know is linked to this center rather than created twice, and their details are left untouched.
students_importShowingFirst: First {n} rows — the full totals are above
students_importErrAlreadyExists: This phone or national ID already exists — re-run the import to link them

centerEmulator.title: Try it yourself — a practice copy of Edura
centerEmulator.missHint: Not that one — look for the control with the indigo outline and press it.
centerEmulator.finishedBody: You can now read your day, price a class so the counter can collect, take cash and check a student in with one action, close the lesson so the centre's share is credited, and read your books — including what a refund really does. Your real centre works exactly the same way.
centerEmulator.sandboxNote: Everything above is practice — the data and prices are invented, no real money moves and no receipt is recorded. The real platform and centre shares appear on your own screen before any closing.

firstRun.title: First time here? Take 3 minutes
firstRun.body: Before you open your centre, let's walk through a practice copy step by step: price a class, take cash at the counter and check the student in with one action, close the lesson so your share lands, and read your books. No real data changes.
firstRun.reopenHint: This tour opens by itself once only. You can reopen it any time from “Guided tour” in the menu.

screens.pricedHint: The price is fixed on the class and is what the counter charges. Changing it later does not re-price past lessons.
screens.unpricedBody: This class has no per-session price, so the counter cannot take money for it and students cannot subscribe. Setting that price is your job as the centre owner.
screens.noLessonHint: Pick a teacher and a lesson above. Student search and new-student registration work either way.
screens.noPriceHint: No lesson price — set it on the classes screen to enable collection here
screens.settleEyebrow: The step that credits the centre
screens.settleTitle: Close the lesson and distribute it
screens.settledBody: The lesson is closed and distributed: the centre's share is in your books and the teacher's is in their wallet. It cannot be closed again and its distribution cannot be edited.
screens.blockedUnpriced: This class has no price, so the lesson would distribute nothing. Set the class pricing first.
screens.blockedNoPresent: Nobody is checked in, so there is nothing to distribute. Check students in at the counter first.
screens.settleAction: Close the lesson and credit the centre EGP {amount} across {n} students
screens.settleHint: The distribution is written to the ledger once, and cannot be undone.
screens.settleArmedHint: Written to the ledger in your name, and credited to the teacher's wallet and the centre's books immediately.
screens.refundFinality: A refund is a new ledger entry and is never deleted — the original receipt stays exactly as it is, with a negative entry added beneath it.

welcome.title: Welcome — this is entirely a practice copy
welcome.body: The screens ahead are exactly your centre's, with invented data: one teacher, one class, five students, and a lesson running right now. Press “Got it” and let's go.

figures.title: The numbers you open on
figures.body: Your students, active classes, centre revenue and attendance rate. “Centre revenue” is YOUR share after distribution — not the cash that passed through the counter.

pending.title: Pending actions are your backlog
pending.body: A class with no price, and a finished lesson never closed. Both genuinely hold money still, and this tour fixes both.

unpriced.title: This is the most dangerous state for a centre
unpriced.body: The class has no price. It is not only that the teacher will not be paid — the counter itself cannot take cash from the student, and students cannot subscribe. The counter's own message names the centre owner as the person who sets it.

setPrice.title: Price it
setPrice.body: Press the button to set the lesson price.

priced.title: Now the counter can collect
priced.body: The price is fixed on the class, the counter charges it, and the lesson has become closable.

pickTeacher.title: Pick the teacher first
pickTeacher.body: The counter starts from a teacher, then that teacher's lessons today. Press the teacher's name.

pickLesson.title: Then pick the lesson
pickLesson.body: The one running now is tagged “Live now”. Press it.

tabs.title: Two tabs, and here is the difference
tabs.body: “Checked in” holds the ones who are done; “All students” holds everyone — paid and not. The counts beside each tab move with every check-in.

unpaidStudent.title: Look at Mariam — “Unpaid”
unpaidStudent.body: Mariam is standing in front of you and has not paid. Her control is not “check in” — it is “collect and check in”, because both happen in one action.

armCollect.title: The button carries the amount itself
armCollect.body: Not “confirm” on a figure you never read. Press it to take the cash.

confirmCollect.title: A second confirmation, on purpose
confirmCollect.body: This writes a receipt and a ledger entry. Press “Final confirmation — cash received”.

collected.title: Paid and checked in, in one step
collected.body: Her state is now “Checked in” and a numbered receipt was issued. There is no second step to forget — and that is the most important thing about this screen.

offRoster.title: And Omar is not on the roster at all
offRoster.body: Tagged “Not on this lesson's roster” — a student who simply turned up today. The counter finds him by name or code and treats him with the same control.

settleCard.title: The cash is not all yours
settleCard.body: EGP 120 was collected, but that is a gross amount waiting to be split. The centre's share is credited when the lesson is CLOSED — this step.

readShares.title: Read the split before you press
readShares.body: The centre's, the teacher's and the platform's share per student. Add them up — they must equal the lesson price exactly. These figures are practice ones; the real rates are set by the platform.

pressSettle.title: Close the lesson
pressSettle.body: Press the button carrying the centre's total.

confirmSettle.title: Final confirmation
confirmSettle.body: The distribution is written to the ledger once and cannot be undone. Press to confirm.

settled.title: The centre's share is credited
settled.body: The lesson is closed, your share entered your books, and the teacher's landed in their wallet at the same moment. If you never close lessons, the cash is collected and the books stay empty — the commonest reason a centre says “the numbers don't add up”.

receipts.title: Every pound has a numbered receipt
receipts.body: The receipt the counter issued is here with the student's name and its number. It is your proof and hers.

netProfit.title: Revenue minus expenses
netProfit.body: “Centre revenue” is your share after distribution, expenses are what you recorded, and net profit is the difference. This figure moves when you CLOSE lessons — not when you take cash.

refund.title: And if you collected by mistake?
refund.body: Press “Refund the last receipt” and watch what the ledger does.

refunded.title: A refund is a new entry, not an erasure
refunded.body: The original receipt stayed exactly where it was, a negative entry was added beneath it, and net profit dropped. The ledger tells the whole story rather than hiding it — which is what makes your figures provable.

done.title: You have walked the centre's whole money path
done.body: You priced, took cash and checked a student in with one action, closed the lesson, read your books and issued a refund. Press “Got it” to finish.

tour.title: A quick tour of Edura
tour.moreHint: On a phone: press “More” first — it's inside there.

welcome.title: Welcome 👋 let's get your centre running
welcome.body: This tour is ordered the way a centre actually comes to life — each step unlocks the next. And it won't just say “these are your classes”, it will show you how. You can skip at any point.

teachers.title: 1. Add your teachers
teachers.body: No teacher, no classes. The invite goes by email and the teacher sets their own password.

how.2: Press add teacher and send the email invite
how.3: They receive a link and set their own password

teachers.note: You never set anyone's password. And for a teacher who won't use the platform at all there's “Off-system teachers” — you key in their work by hand and it still appears in your reports.

rooms.title: 2. Register your rooms
rooms.body: A room isn't just a name — it's what prevents timetable clashes, and it carries your share of each lesson.

how.2: Add the room and its capacity
how.3: Choose its pricing method: a share of the lesson, or an amount per attending student

rooms.note: If you choose per-attending-student, the teacher sees that figure when booking — so set it correctly from the start.

classes.title: 3. Create the classes
classes.body: A class ties a teacher to a subject, a room and times — and the lessons generate themselves.

how.2: Press create class
how.3: Pick the subject, year, teacher and room
how.4: Set the times — clashes are prevented for you

pricing.title: 4. Price the class — without this there's no money
pricing.body: An unpriced class can't be subscribed to, its lessons refuse to close, and the teacher is paid nothing.

how.1: From “Classes”, open the class and press edit
how.2: Set the monthly price, the per-lesson price, or both
how.3: Choose the settlement basis: class price, lesson price, or each student's own subscription

pricing.note: You price your centre's classes — the teacher cannot. A class created by accepting a collaboration request starts at zero, so it needs pricing.

counter.title: 5. The counter — this is the daily work
counter.body: The screen the queue stands in front of: today's lessons for a teacher, who has checked in and who hasn't, and taking cash and marking attendance from the same place.

how.2: Pick the teacher — whoever is teaching right now is already selected
how.3: Pick the lesson from the strip
how.4: Find the student by code or name, or scan their card
how.5: If they're not subscribed: take the cash and check them in, in one step

counter.note: A student not on the roster is found by search and checked in normally. A brand-new student is registered from this same screen and receives a link to finish signing up.

students.title: 6. Your students
students.body: The centre's full roster — and you can upload a list you already have instead of typing it in.

how.2: For one student: add student
how.3: For a whole list: import from an Excel/CSV file
how.4: Run the dry run first — it tells you how many would be added and how many already exist, before anything is written

students.note: The import recognises an existing student by phone or national ID and reuses their account rather than creating a second one. And importing records no money — names only.

requests.title: 7. Enrolment requests
requests.body: Students who asked to join your classes are waiting for your answer here.

how.2: Check the student and the class
how.3: Accept or reject

schedule.title: 8. The schedule
schedule.body: Every lesson in the centre in one place — and you can close a lesson from here.

how.2: See the week's lessons by room
how.3: Open a lesson to cancel, postpone or close it

schedule.note: Closing a lesson is what distributes its revenue to the teacher, the centre and the platform. It's written to the ledger once and cannot be undone.

cash.title: 9. Payments and subscriptions
cash.body: The record of every pound that came in — and where you record a cash subscription.

how.2: Review the payments and subscriptions
how.3: To record a cash subscription: pick the student, the class and the amount, and confirm

cash.note: Cash is written to exactly the same ledger as online payments, with a numbered receipt.

reports.title: 10. Reports
reports.body: Attendance, fill rates and net profit — and you can export them.

how.2: Choose the period
how.3: Press export to download a CSV or print

reports.note: The money reports are for the accountant or for you — a manager sees attendance and fill rates only, not revenue.

expenses.title: 11. Expenses
expenses.body: For “net profit” to actually be net, your expenses have to be recorded.

how.2: Add the expense with its type, amount and date

staff.title: 12. Your staff
staff.body: Not every staff member sees everything. You choose their tier and they set their own password.

how.2: Add a staff member and choose their tier
how.3: Receptionist: the counter, students and messages
how.4: Manager: all that plus rooms and reports
how.5: Accountant: money only — and no messaging

staff.note: They receive an email invite and set their own password — you never type it.

audit.title: 13. The audit log
audit.body: Every sensitive action in your centre is recorded: who did it and when.

how.2: Filter by staff member or by action type

audit.note: This log cannot be edited or deleted — not by you and not by anyone. That's what makes it evidence.

practice.title: And if you'd rather try it first
practice.body: There's a full practice copy you can rehearse on without touching your centre.

how.2: It walks you through the whole operating loop
how.3: All the data is invented and no money moves

finish.title: That's it — your turn 🎉
finish.body: The tour is done. Start with teachers and rooms — without them there are no classes, and without a price there's no money. And “Your first steps” on your dashboard keeps track with you.

staffTour.title: A quick tour of Edura
staffTour.moreHint: On a phone: press “More” first — it's inside there.

welcomeReception.title: Welcome 👋 you're on the counter
welcomeReception.body: This screen isn't a menu — it's where you work. From here you see who has arrived and who hasn't, and you take cash and mark attendance without leaving it. The tour is short and you can skip it.

welcomeManager.title: Welcome 👋 you're the centre manager
welcomeManager.body: You have all the counter work, plus rooms and reports. This tour covers both, step by step.

welcomeAccountant.title: Welcome 👋 you're the centre accountant
welcomeAccountant.body: Your account is for money only — deliberately. This tour is short because your work is in one place.

boardTeacher.title: Start by picking the teacher and lesson
boardTeacher.body: It's the first row on the screen, and you do it once at the start of a shift.

how.1: Pick the teacher — whoever is teaching right now is already selected
how.2: Pick the lesson from the strip below
how.3: Once picked, the whole row collapses to one line

boardTeacher.note: Outside lesson hours nothing is picked for you — choose it yourself.

boardTabs.title: The two tabs — this is what you work
boardTabs.body: “Checked in” and “Not yet”. The number beside each tells you where you are in the queue.

how.2: “Checked in” = done
how.3: Both together = the lesson's full roster

boardTabs.note: Search covers the whole roster whichever tab is open — so nobody gets lost.

boardSearch.title: How to find the student
boardSearch.body: Every way of searching, on one row.

how.1: Type the student's code — fastest, and they know it
how.2: Or their name or phone number
how.3: Or press the camera and scan their card
how.4: If they're not on this lesson's roster, press search and it looks across the whole centre

boardSearch.note: The “search all of a student's lessons” button goes to the other screen — it answers a different question: “this student is in front of me, which lesson is theirs?”

boardCash.title: Take the cash and check them in — one step
boardCash.body: The most common case: the student is in front of you with the lesson's money.

how.1: If subscribed: press check in, done
how.2: If not: choose the plan (single lesson or a month)
how.3: Take the cash
how.4: Press collect and check in — both happen at once

boardCash.note: A numbered receipt is issued and the payment is written to the ledger immediately — with exactly the same entries as an online payment.

boardWalkIn.title: A new student who isn't in the system
boardWalkIn.body: You register them from this same screen, and they get a link to finish signing up themselves.

how.2: Enter their name and phone number
how.3: Enter the guardian's email if available — otherwise their phone
how.4: They get a student code immediately and you can take payment

boardWalkIn.note: If that phone is already registered, the system reuses the existing account instead of creating a second one — so duplicates aren't a worry.

students.title: The centre's student roster
students.body: Every student, with their codes and numbers.

how.2: Search by name, code or phone
how.3: Open a student to see their subscriptions and payments

importStudents.title: How to upload a whole roster
importStudents.body: If you have a list in Excel, upload it instead of typing it in.

how.2: Upload an Excel or CSV file
how.3: Run the dry run first — it tells you how many would be added and how many already exist
how.4: If the numbers look right, run it

importStudents.note: Importing records no money and no subscriptions — names only. Existing students are recognised by phone or national ID.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: Add the room and its capacity; clashes are prevented for you.

how.2: Add the room and its capacity
how.3: Set its pricing method

reports.title: The reports available to you
reports.body: Attendance and fill rates — and you can export them.

how.2: Choose the period
how.3: Press export to download a CSV or print

reports.note: Revenue reports are not in your tier — those are the accountant's or the owner's. Ask them if you need one.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: You message students and their parents.

how.2: Press new conversation
how.3: Pick the name — the list only shows who you're allowed to reach

finance.title: The money screen
finance.body: Every payment, subscription and receipt in one place.

how.2: Review the payments and subscriptions
how.3: Open any payment to see its receipt

exports.title: How to export the reports
exports.body: These figures come out as a file that opens in Excel.

how.1: On the reports screen pick the report and the period
how.2: Press export — CSV or print
how.3: The file opens with Arabic rendered correctly in Excel

exports.note: The numbers in the file are exactly the ones on screen — they come from the same source.

noMessaging.title: Why you have no messaging
noMessaging.body: Your tier has no messaging, and that's deliberate rather than an oversight: the accountant sees the money and does not correspond with students or parents.

how.1: If you need to reach someone, speak to the owner or the manager
how.2: And to leave the team a note, use “Team Notes”

notes.title: Team notes
notes.body: A to-do board for the team — not messages: these are things that get done and closed.

how.2: Write the note
how.3: Anyone on the team can mark it done or declined

notes.note: Simply opening the board records that you read it — so the team knows who has seen what.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: What happened while you weren't on the screen.

how.2: For phone alerts: enable push notifications in Settings

finish.title: That's it — your turn 🎉
finish.body: The tour is done. Your work starts on this screen — pick the teacher and the lesson and go.

takings_methodNote: Total takings. A cash / online breakdown is not available yet.
queue_unsettledFact: A finished lesson that was never closed — its money has not been split yet.
queue_clashFact: A hall or a teacher booked twice at the same time.
agreements_hint: This is a proposal only — no rate takes effect before the platform approves it.
agreements_rateForTeacher: The teacher's take (center keeps the rest)
agreements_rateForCenter: The center's share (teacher keeps the rest)
agreements_roomOnlyWarning: All of this teacher's current groups are hall-based — the agreement will only govern no-hall groups.
agreements_failed: The proposal was not sent — try again.
